description: The any_to_str_bytes doc explains TeletexString is intentionally not normalized due to vendor incompatibility. This creates a class of support issues when users hit TeletexString mismatches: 'Can you normalize it like BMPString?' The doc defends the position, but maintainers will see this question repeatedly. Consider adding a FAQ/LIMITATIONS section to rustdoc explaining this is not a bug and why, to deflect support questions earlier.
title: TeletexString byte-exact comparison will generate repeating support questions
